question.prompt: Quickly moving a pen tip across paper leaves a line. This phenomenon illustrates that

solutions.explanation: A pen tip can be regarded as a point. A moving point forms a line, which illustrates that “a moving point generates a line.”
solutions.title: Identify the moving geometric object
